title: Shattering Oozing Mochi
description: A unique dessert featuring a shattering exterior and an oozing anko center. This Japanese-inspired treat combines the textures of crunchy and gooey for a fascinating culinary experience.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine glutinous rice flour, granulated sugar, and shattering sugar.
2. Gradually add water to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
3. Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
4. Divide the dough into small balls and flatten each ball into a disk shape.
5. Place a spoonful of red bean paste in the center of each disk.
6. Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges to seal the mochi.
7. Heat the soy milk in a saucepan over medium heat until it starts to simmer.
8. Add the peppery sesame oil to the soy milk and stir to combine.
9. Dip each mochi into the soy milk mixture and coat evenly.
10. Place the coated mochi on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
11. Chill the mochi in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes.
12. Serve the shattering oozing mochi chilled and enjoy!
